assessment: The authors largely improved the paper with additional analyses and extensive revisions. By employing scRNA-seq analyses, they elegantly have dissected the endothelial cell (EC) heterogeneity of cardiac blood vessels across development in mouse and human. They convincingly demonstrate that the EC heterogeneities of cardiac blood vessels are sequentially governed by the progenitor sources and environmental cues during initial and late development. Moreover, they show that these ECs become homogeneous in adult. They also claim that human fetal hearts take on generally a similar path for establishment of cardiac blood vessels. Overall, this study is novel and intriguing.
